el: Greek, informal 'εσύ', Greek wine-trade usage; Greek PDO names in Greek with the Latin form where useful
ja: Japanese, です/ます style, natural Japanese wine-education wording (ワイン検定 terms, カタカナ grape names as used in Japan)
ko: Korean, 해요체, Korean wine-education wording, grape names as used in Korea
zh-hant: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/Hong Kong usage), natural wine-education wording, grape names as used in Taiwan
pt: European Portuguese (Portugal), 'tu' register, Portuguese wine-trade usage
tr: Turkish, informal 'sen', Turkish wine-trade usage (WSET Seviye 1/2/3)
th: Thai, polite neutral register with no gendered particles (no ครับ/ค่ะ), Thai wine-education wording
pl: Polish, informal 'ty', neutral (avoid gendered verb forms addressed to the reader, use impersonal/plural)
ru: Russian, informal 'ты' or neutral impersonal constructions avoiding gendered past tense addressed to the reader
zh-hans: Simplified Chinese (mainland usage), natural wine-education wording, grape names as used in mainland China
ar: Modern Standard Arabic, neutral wording (avoid gendered second-person forms where possible), grape and region names in Arabic with Latin form where useful
